cards.html:
Myth vs fact

Short sleep makes you hungrier.

✗ MYTH

Night hunger is just weak willpower.

✓ FACT

Sleep loss shifts two hunger hormones.

Meet the pair

Ghrelin

From your stomach: “eat now.”

Leptin

From body fat: “you're full.”

Lab test · 2004

12 young men

2 nights of 4 hours in bed vs 2 nights of 10 hours.

After short sleep

Leptin↓18%
Ghrelin↑28%
Hunger↑24%

Real life too

1,000+ adults

5-hour sleepers had ~15% less leptin and ~15% more ghrelin than 8-hour sleepers.

Save this for your gym partner who sleeps 5 hours.
